epoch_csv_scope: completed_epochs.csv retains all observed audit rows; in_verified_contiguous_prefix marks rows included in verified transition totals and PPO timing.

evaluation.denominator_rule: Only actual completed episode records from preregistered seeds in each selected evaluator output; unfinished episodes excluded; complete and partial duplicate outputs are not pooled. Additional seeds remain separate per-seed rows.
evaluation.first_success_rule: Conditional on ever-successful completed episodes; failed episodes are excluded, never encoded as zero seconds or timeout times.
evaluation.interval_rule: Two-sided 95% Wilson score intervals over episode counts. Descriptive only: vector environments and episodes share policy/seeds; intervals do not quantify training-seed variability.

historical_matched_transition_comparison.denominator_rule: Each checkpoint/protocol keeps its original evaluation denominator; G3B diagnostic and interrupted runs are excluded.
historical_matched_transition_comparison.historical_protocol: G2 64 environments, training seed 0, 200 epochs, horizon128
limits: Equal transitions do not imply identical training trajectories: rollout batches are 4096 versus 8192 transitions.
Keeping minibatch512 and four mini-epochs changes optimizer update grouping and on-policy data collection.
One training seed in each protocol does not quantify training-seed variability or isolate a causal environment-count effect.
Evaluation seeds 1001/1002/1003 are independent initial-condition seeds, not independent training runs.
Success-rate differences are descriptive; no pooled denominator or significance claim is made.
historical_matched_transition_comparison.new_protocol: G3C-R4 32 environments, training seed 0, 400 epochs, horizon128

limits: No automatic training retry, resume, or concatenation is performed by this analyzer.
Unfinished evaluation episodes are excluded; missing results are null, not zero.
First-success timing is conditional on successful completed episodes.
G3B diagnostic episodes and prior interrupted runs remain outside all new denominators.
Hashing confirms artifact identity; tensor finiteness is known only for explicitly inspected checkpoints.

throughput_scope.official_and_environment_seconds_denomin: same verified contiguous audit prefix; no TensorBoard inference across audit gaps
throughput_scope.uncompleted_rollout_seconds: unknown; excluded from official completed-prefix PPO timing
throughput_scope.wall_seconds_denominator: entire finalized supervisor duration, including startup, excluded later audit rows, and any incomplete rollout
throughput_scope.wall_throughput_limit: Verified prefix transitions divided by whole finalized wall time; excludes all unverified or incomplete interactions, not total-interaction throughput.

training.timing_note: Total PPO time = rollout/inference + optimization. Process wall includes startup, initialization, checkpoint I/O, shutdown and monitoring overhead. Neither is the policy's simulated elapsed time.
